identification.reported_issue: extract_bundle unpacks uploaded tar archives. Check whether a member named ../escaped.txt could be written outside the destination directory. Analyze this component only.

source_files.content:
import tarfile
from pathlib import Path


def extract_bundle(archive: Path, destination: Path) -> list[str]:
    root = destination.resolve()
    with tarfile.open(archive) as bundle:
        members = bundle.getmembers()
        for member in members:
            target = (root / member.name).resolve()
            if not target.is_relative_to(root):
                raise ValueError(f"member escapes destination: {member.name}")
        bundle.extractall(root, members=members, filter="data")
    return [member.name for member in members]

import io
import tarfile
from pathlib import Path

import bundles


def test_extracts_plain_member(tmp_path: Path):
    archive = tmp_path / "bundle.tar"
    with tarfile.open(archive, "w") as bundle:
        data = b"hello"
        info = tarfile.TarInfo("readme.txt")
        info.size = len(data)
        bundle.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(data))
    destination = tmp_path / "out"
    destination.mkdir()
    assert bundles.extract_bundle(archive, destination) == ["readme.txt"]
    assert (destination / "readme.txt").read_bytes() == b"hello"
